modify one of the aircraft designs they had been manufacturing under licence during [[World War I]], the [[Hansa-Brandenburg B.I]].{{cite web | of Jan Kouril.{{cite magazine|title=Issue 28 – Aero L-39 Albatros|date=3 October 2016|issue=28|magazine=Aviation
